_meta.description: VANILLA Morrowind item locations parsed from the game ESMs: where each item of interest is placed in the world, which containers hold it, which NPCs carry or sell it (restock = merchant stock), and which leveled loot lists can spawn it. Covers equipment (vanilla_ref.json), alchemy ingredients, books, apparatus, repair/security tools, soul gems, and scrolls. VANILLA BASELINE ONLY.

conventions.vanilla_baseline: These are the shipped game's placements. The server can relocate, remove, or add copies of anything; when an NP-side difference is captured, it belongs in an np_override field on the record (none recorded yet) — until then, answer with the vanilla placement labeled as the vanilla baseline.
conventions.condensed: High-count items list totals plus top examples (cells by count; up to 12 each). 'sellers_restock' NPCs restock the item every restock cycle — the reliable buy source.
conventions.lookup: Keys are lowercase ESM ids. Join from vanilla_ref.json / alchemy.json / vanilla_lore_books.json via their esm_id fields.
conventions.test_cells: Developer test cells (ToddTest, Clutter Warehouse, Character Stuff Wonderland, etc.) are excluded — they are unreachable in normal play.

s-esm.note: Parsed from local Morrowind/Tribunal/Bloodmoon ESMs (CELL references, CONT/NPC_/CREA inventories, LEVI lists).
